notes.title: Temporary workaround for current bugs
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's Marten here, once again with some Defunct news. Since the last update we've published for the game, we've been encountering some bugs in the game, which we haven't able to crush just yet. Now, as a [b] temporary [/b] update, we're going to do the following.

From now on, when you start the game, you'll get the option of choosing between playing in the current version (V1.0.2) or the previous version (V1.0.1). Choosing for the previous version will ensure that your experience is optimal as you won't encounter any of the following bugs:
[list]
[*]An issue where players can't pick up boosts properly in some instances
[*]Issues with collectibles, not registering properly
[*]Clipping issues, in rare cases players are falling through the map
[*]Lighting bugs
[*]Issues with audio levels
[/list]
Please be aware that when you play the game in v1.0.1, you'll start with a fresh save file. If you've played Defunct on V1.0.1. before, you'll continue with the last save game made in that version. This doesn't mean that your previous progress will be wiped, though. Once we're updating the game to v1.0.3, the save game from v1.0.2 will be preserved.

Also, the v1.0.2 was mainly a language update, so just the following languages will be available in v1.0.1
[list]
[*]English
[*]French
[*]Spanish
[*]Italian 
[*]German 
[*]Swedish
[*]Dutch
[/list]
In the meantime, we're working our uhm... gravitize engines off to fix the bugs in the most recent version, so we can finally get some rest ːsteamboredː

If there's any questions, let me know in the comments below!

notes.title: Post GDQ & Minor patch
notes.content:
Hello speedsters!

Thanks for an awesome SGDQ, it was an honor to be part of such a fantastic event.
First a message to all of our new players!
If you're interested in speed-running the game (or just want to hang out with people) you can always join the official Discord channel: https://discordapp.com/invite/0wiFJQrwEAwwZEcI
There you will get help starting out and learn all them strats!


So another minor patch is up and running!
It came to our attention that some players had problems with the camera bugging out. This turned out to be a Field of View(FoV) issue.
Another problem maker were those pesky zip-lines. They sometimes sent you flying in the opposite direction if you hit them in certain ways. 
These should both be resolved. Keep letting us know what problems you're having and we'll do our best to resolve them.

Fixes:
Fixed the Camera bug associated with the FoV sliders.
Fixed so that Zip-lines don’t send you flying in the opposite direction.


As for players having issues with the Xbox Elite controller, we're going to do another minor update soon that we think are going to resolve your problems as well.

tags.bug: Fixed the Camera bug associated with the FoV sliders.
Fixed so that Zip-lines don’t send you flying in the opposite direction.

notes.title: Small patch with input from our speedrunning community
notes.content:
Hey everyone

A small patch has just been deployed for Defunct. Most of the input was submitted by the people that are speedrunning Defunct. This way the levels are better optimised which helps them with setting a new record time!

For those of you that don't know, Defunct is participating in Games Done Quick (Summer Edition) this year. We'll get some more info out once we get closer to the date but just something we wanted to share with the community

[list]Fixes [/list]
[*] The junkyard won't be locked up when you use the Dawn skip from now on.
[*] Rockbottom doesn't stay locked when you use the Oasis skip.
[*] Music won't disappear when you restart a level.

tags.bug: The junkyard won't be locked up when you use the Dawn skip from now on.
Rockbottom doesn't stay locked when you use the Oasis skip.
Music won't disappear when you restart a level.
